title: Tropical Sri Lanka Super Deluxe: Kandy, Sigiriya and Bentota
alt: Sunset over the pool of a four star beach resort at Bentota
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel in the hills above Kandy town

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

activities.name: Excursion to Sigiriya rock fortress
activities.description: A full day out to the fifth century rock citadel: the water gardens, the mirror wall, the frescoes and the summit palace ruins.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights in the hill capital with the elephant sanctuary on the way in, a dance show the first evening and a full day out to Sigiriya.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star colonial cottage hotel above Nuwara Eliya

activities.name: Full day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the Peradeniya gardens, the Bahiravokanda Buddha and the gem museum.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: A full day of Kandy sights, then up into tea country for a night in a four star colonial cottage.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star beachfront resort on the Bentota strand

activities.name: Full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing
activities.description: Ramboda Falls, a working tea estate and factory, Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, Hakgala gardens and the Seetha Amman temple.

activities.name: Excursion to Galle and Mirissa
activities.description: South along the coast to the Dutch fort at Galle with its ramparts and lighthouse, then on to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Down from the hills to a four star beachfront resort: a full day of waterfalls and tea estates on the way, then Galle and Mirissa from your base.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Mount Lavinia beachfront south of the city

activities.name: Full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A final night in the capital with a full day of its temples, colonial quarter and markets.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy
day_titles.3: Kandy sights and the climb to Nuwara Eliya

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in at your Kandy hotel in the afternoon
An evening lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the road north through the Cultural Triangle
The water gardens and the climb past the mirror wall
Frescoes of the cloud maidens and the lion paw terrace
Summit ruins and views across the dry zone jungle
Back to Kandy for dinner at the hotel
3: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
The hilltop Buddha at Bahiravokanda and Peradeniya gardens
A transfer through the tea estates to Nuwara Eliya
Check in and an evening walk by Gregory Lake
4: Breakfast, then Ramboda Falls and a tea factory visit
Gregory Lake, Victoria Park and the Hakgala gardens
The Seetha Amman temple of the Ramayana trail
A long transfer down to Bentota and check in at the beach
5: Breakfast and an excursion along the southern coast
The Dutch fort at Galle: ramparts, lighthouse and old church
Mirissa beach and sunset from Coconut Tree Hill
6: Breakfast and a transfer down the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: The Tropical Sri Lanka route in upgraded hotels: two nights in Kandy with the Pinnawala elephants and a day at Sigiriya, a four star colonial cottage in Nuwara Eliya, two nights at a four star beach resort in Bentota with Galle and Mirissa, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 6 nights in deluxe and four star hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; a full day excursion to Sigiriya; full day Kandy sightseeing; full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing; a day excursion to Galle and Mirissa; full day Colombo sightseeing.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
